headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United consider defensive clearout in summer
description: Manchester United are considering refreshing their back four, with three senior defender's contracts up at the end of the season. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Michael Carrick set to lead Man United vs. Bournemouth amid pressure - sources
description: Michael Carrick is set to be in charge of Manchester United against Bournemouth this weekend, sources have told ESPN, as he battles to keep his job at Old Trafford.

headline: Bruno Guimarães: I had sleepless nights over Arsenal move
description: Bruno Guimarães has admitted he had sleepless nights over his decision to leave Newcastle United for Arsenal.

headline: Enzo Maresca: 'It's my duty' to help Phil Foden rediscover best Man City form
description: Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca feels a duty to help Phil Foden return to his best.

headline: Who is to blame at Manchester United?
description: Who is to blame at Manchester United?

headline: Man United players get Thursday day off despite Como thrashing - sources
description: Manchester United's first-team squad will report back for training on Friday after being given a day off on Thursday following the humiliating 4-1 Champions League defeat against Como, sources have told ESPN.
